# Abbreviations

<!-- source: https://publications.pages.asam.net/standards/ASAM_OpenDRIVE/ASAM_OpenDRIVE_Specification/v1.9.0/specification/04_abbreviations/04_abbreviations.html -->

## 4 Abbreviations

API
:   Application Programming Interface

ASAM
:   Association for Standardization of Automation and Measuring Systems

CRG
:   Curved Regular Grid

ECU
:   Electronic Control Unit

EPSG
:   European Petroleum Survey Group Geodesy

GPS
:   Global Positioning System

GRS80
:   Geodetic Reference System 1980

HEX
:   Hexadecimal

HOV
:   High-Occupancy Vehicle

IEEE
:   Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers

ISO
:   International Organization for Standardization

LED
:   Light-Emitting Diode

LHT
:   Left-Hand Traffic

OSI
:   Open Simulation Interface

PROJ
:   PROJ coordinate transformation software library

RGB
:   Red Green Blue

RHT
:   Right-Hand Traffic

SPDX
:   Software Package Data Exchange

TM
:   Transverse Mercator

UID
:   Unique Identifier

UML
:   Unified Modeling Language

URL
:   Uniform Resource Locator

USA
:   United States of America

UTM
:   Universal Transverse Mercator

VMS
:   Variable Message Sign

W3C
:   World Wide Web Consortium

WGS 84
:   World Geodetic System 1984

XML
:   Extensible Markup Language

XSD
:   XML Schema Definition
